title: 真实Zabbix LLD误过滤止损：同ID恢复在线bond，暂停删除并保留旧history
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 已计数ID证据升级，实际LLD对象/状态与历史验证；新增改编题量零。
rubric: 保留发现原始JSON及变更前后过滤规则；确认接口仍在发现输出中，却因新宏正则不匹配被排除，随后触发已配置的丢失资源清理。
立即评估延长或暂停清理并修正规则，在小范围重新发现；核对原对象是否仍可恢复和历史是否保留，已删除对象不保证可直接找回。
验收包括应发现与应排除两组接口及清理等待期。

conversion.original_title: 调整LLD接口过滤规则后，仍在线接口的监控项被标记为丢失并随后删除，如何止损？

body:
## 操作任务
实现plan_lld_recovery(rule,observed,include,exclude,pattern)。题定独立非继承/非发现LLD rule，仅一个{#IFNAME} operator=8匹配条件、evaltype=0。三个名称列表必须唯一、仅ASCII字母数字_.-且1..64字符，include非空、与exclude不交且两组均出现在本次observed。pattern为审批提供的、Python/PCRE共用简单子集内的有锚正则（最长128），须匹配所有include且不匹配任一exclude；本题仅有限样本证明，不证明所有未来名称。仅修改该条件value，生成update含原itemid、完整filter及lifetime_type=1（Zabbix7.0“不删除”，2为立即删除），生成rollback保留原filter和原lifetime_type；其余字段不进入更新，原对象不变，history_restored=False。拒绝未知清理策略、错误结构/继承对象、遗漏观测和不合矩阵的正则；不假定已删除对象或历史能自动找回。 验收在真实服务端先创建eth0/bond0/old0及history；误过滤后原始JSON仍含bond0但原项lost。应用批准计划后bond0以同一itemid恢复，old0不得被立即删除，旧history保留，lo仍排除，恢复后新采样继续入库。发现名称是受控教学输入，不冒充真实网卡枚举。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py真实LLD、history及保留边界验证。

## 能力边界
真实Zabbix7.0.32 LLD manager/worker、官方私有PG15.19及trapper/history；验证尚未删除对象的止损、同ID恢复和保留策略，未承诺已删除对象或旧history重建。学习者返回更新/回退计划，仅由私有判分器应用，不运行PHP前端/JSON-RPC API、不部署或构建镜像。既有099题证据升级，新增题量零。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,json,time,copy,subprocess,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from zabbix_server_fixture import PrivateServer
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with PrivateServer() as server:
 db=server.db
 db.execute("INSERT INTO hosts(hostid,host,name,status) VALUES(1000000,'training-node','Private training node',0); INSERT INTO items(itemid,hostid,type,name,key_,value_type,history,trends,flags,lifetime,lifetime_type) VALUES(1000001,1000000,2,'Interface discovery','net.if.discovery',4,'0','0',1,'1h',0); INSERT INTO item_rtdata(itemid) VALUES(1000001); INSERT INTO item_condition(item_conditionid,itemid,operator,macro,value) VALUES(1000004,1000001,8,'{#IFNAME}','^(eth[0-9]+|bond[0-9]+|old[0-9]+)$'); INSERT INTO items(itemid,hostid,type,name,key_,value_type,history,trends,flags) VALUES(1000002,1000000,2,'Interface {#IFNAME}','if.packet[{#IFNAME}]',3,'1d','0',2); INSERT INTO item_discovery(itemdiscoveryid,itemid,parent_itemid) VALUES(1000003,1000002,1000001)")
 server.start()
 def reload():
  offset=server.log.stat().st_size;result=subprocess.run(['zabbix_server','-c',str(server.config),'-R','config_cache_reload'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3);assert result.returncode==0
  server.wait(lambda:'finished forced reloading of the configuration cache' in server.log.read_text()[offset:],'current rule/item configuration loaded')
 def discovery(names):
  payload=json.dumps([{'{#IFNAME}':name,'{#PROBE_SEQ}':str(time.time_ns())} for name in names]);stamp,result=server.send(payload,key='net.if.discovery');assert result['response']=='success' and 'processed: 1; failed: 0;' in result['info'];return payload
 def rows():return db.execute('select itemid,key_,flags,status from items where hostid=1000000 order by itemid')
 def actual(name):return db.execute("select i.itemid,d.status,i.status from items i join item_discovery d on d.itemid=i.itemid where i.hostid=1000000 and i.key_='if.packet["+name+"]'")
 def history(name,value):
  reload();stamp,result=server.send(value,key='if.packet['+name+']');assert 'processed: 1; failed: 0;' in result['info'],result
  server.wait(lambda:db.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid='+actual(name)[0][0]+' and clock='+str(stamp//1000000000)+' and ns='+str(stamp%1000000000))==[[str(value)]],'discovered item real history committed')
 initial=discovery(['eth0','bond0','old0','lo']);server.wait(lambda:len(rows())==5,'three actual initially discovered interfaces')
 for name,value in (('eth0',11),('bond0',7),('old0',23)):history(name,value)
 identities={name:actual(name)[0][0] for name in ('eth0','bond0','old0')};original_history=db.execute('select itemid,value from history_uint where itemid in('+','.join(identities.values())+') order by itemid,value')
 db.execute("update item_condition set value='^eth[0-9]+$' where item_conditionid=1000004; update items set lifetime_type=0 where itemid=1000001");reload();raw=discovery(['eth0','bond0','lo'])
 server.wait(lambda:actual('bond0') and actual('bond0')[0][1]=='1' and actual('old0') and actual('old0')[0][1]=='1','online bond excluded by filter and marked lost')
 assert actual('eth0')[0][1]=='0' and actual('bond0')[0][0]==identities['bond0'] and 'bond0' in raw
 print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_LLD_ONLINE_BOND_PRESENT_IN_RAW_JSON_BUT_EXCLUDED_AND_LOST_PENDING_RETENTION_DELETE',flush=True)
 filt=dict(evaltype='0',conditions=[dict(macro='{#IFNAME}',operator='8',value='^eth[0-9]+$')]);rule=dict(itemid='1000001',flags='1',templateid='0',filter=filt,lifetime_type='0');before=copy.deepcopy(rule)
 prototype=db.execute('select itemid,key_,flags,type,value_type,history,trends from items where itemid=1000002');config_hash=hashlib.sha256(server.config.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:plan_lld_recovery_actual_objects_and_history',flush=True)
 result=task.plan_lld_recovery(rule,['eth0','bond0','lo'],['eth0','bond0'],['lo'],'^(eth[0-9]+|bond[0-9]+)$')
 assert set(result)=={'update','rollback','history_restored'} and result['history_restored'] is False and rule==before
 assert result['rollback']==dict(itemid='1000001',filter=filt,lifetime_type=0),'original rollback parameters lost'
 update=result['update'];assert set(update)=={'itemid','filter','lifetime_type'} and update['itemid']=='1000001' and type(update['lifetime_type']) is int and update['lifetime_type'] in (0,1,2)
 conditions=update['filter']['conditions'];assert str(update['filter']['evaltype'])=='0' and len(conditions)==1 and conditions[0]['macro']=='{#IFNAME}' and str(conditions[0]['operator'])=='8';pattern=conditions[0]['value'];assert isinstance(pattern,str) and len(pattern)<=128
 db.execute("update item_condition set value='"+pattern.replace("'","''")+"' where item_conditionid=1000004; update items set lifetime_type="+str(update['lifetime_type'])+' where itemid=1000001');reload();discovery(['eth0','bond0','lo'])
 server.wait(lambda:actual('bond0') and actual('bond0')[0][1:] == ['0','0'],'approved bond recovered by real LLD')
 until=time.monotonic()+1
 while time.monotonic()<until:
  assert actual('old0') and actual('old0')[0][0]==identities['old0'],'lost object was deleted by unsafe immediate cleanup policy';time.sleep(.04)
 assert actual('eth0')[0][0]==identities['eth0'] and actual('bond0')[0][0]==identities['bond0'],'remaining object identities must be retained, not recreated'
 assert len(rows())==5 and not any('if.packet[lo]'==row[1] for row in rows()),'excluded interface appeared or retained objects removed'
 assert db.execute('select itemid,value from history_uint where itemid in('+','.join(identities.values())+') order by itemid,value')==original_history
 assert db.execute('select lifetime_type from items where itemid=1000001')==[['1']],'lost resource deletion must be paused rather than merely delayed'
 history('bond0',9);assert db.execute('select value from history_uint where itemid='+identities['bond0']+' order by value')==[['7'],['9']]
 assert prototype==db.execute('select itemid,key_,flags,type,value_type,history,trends from items where itemid=1000002') and hashlib.sha256(server.config.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==config_hash
 print('NATIVE_ZABBIX_LLD_SAME_ITEM_ID_RECOVERY_LOST_OBJECT_RETAINED_OLD_HISTORY_KEPT_AND_NEW_BOND_SAMPLE_PERSISTED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
